baseline_models.focus_anchor: The governing dispatch verb and the coordinated sequence شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The commission forms a temporal epistemic relay: the messenger carries an utterance, witnessing makes the present publicly knowable, glad tidings detects the first visible edge of a favorable future, and warning converts a feared future into present caution.

activation_trace.role: The carried utterance and its bearer supply the relay that transports all three functions.
Presence joined to seeing anchors the relay in an inspectable present.
Knowledge made declarative turns observed presence into communicable evidence.
First signs and forerunners let a future good become readable before completion.
Notice of danger projects the other future into the present by awakening caution.

changed_reading.before: A list of three honorific communication roles.
changed_reading.after: A single relay links witnessed reality to two actionable horizons: incipient good and avoidable danger.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of شَاهِدًا and مُبَشِّرًا within a commission addressed directly to the messenger.
baseline_models.mechanism: The envoy is an embodied interface rather than a disembodied voice. His tongue and visible presence disclose what he bears; direct encounter brings the matter to the human surface; congruence between outward appearance and inward reality makes the disclosure credible; warning makes concealed danger perceptible.

activation_trace.role: The bearer of a carried saying supplies the embodied vehicle of disclosure.
The witnessing tongue makes its bearer outwardly legible through expression.
The visible skin or surface locates reception on the publicly perceptible exterior.
Direct contact and personal handling make the commission encounter-based rather than merely reported.
Joined outer and inner completeness supplies the credibility condition for the visible interface.
Warning brings a hidden threat to the audience's perceptual and practical surface.

changed_reading.before: The messenger verbally reports testimony, good news, and warning.
changed_reading.after: His present body, expression, and direct encounter are part of how testimony becomes visible, joy reaches faces, and danger becomes perceptible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَرْسَلْنَاكَ governs all three role nouns, while glad tidings and warning pull affect in opposite directions.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sending is a controlled release rather than an unbounded discharge. Witnessing supplies calibration, glad tidings permits hopeful approach, warning checks unsafe approach, and the branch of deliberateness keeps both movements measured.

activation_trace.role: Release in contrast to holding supplies the commission's forward motion.
Gentleness, deliberation, and verification constrain that release to a measured pace.
Declaration grounded in knowledge calibrates when approach or restraint is warranted.
Joy-opening news supplies the inviting pole of the regulated movement.
Danger-awakening notice supplies the restraining pole without canceling movement.

changed_reading.before: Sending means simply delivering three messages.
changed_reading.after: The commission is a regulator of movement: evidence times a measured release between hope-driven approach and caution-driven restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening immediately before the focus ayah turns the epistemic relay into an opening apparatus. Dispatch carries the opening onward: witness separates and exposes what was closed, glad tidings shows its first aperture, and warning opens foresight before danger closes around the hearer.

activation_trace.role: Release supplies the human continuation of the prior opening.
Evidence-bearing declaration makes an opened matter publicly decidable.
A first sign acts as the small visible aperture of what is still arriving.
The opening of a closure supplies the spatial action that the mission communicates and extends.
Release from conceptual closure makes witnessing an opening of understanding, not only of territory.
Manifest disclosure gives the opening an evidentiary surface recognizable by a witness.

structural_cues: 48:1 and 48:8 repeat إِنَّا with a first-person plural act directed toward the same second-person recipient, pairing opening and sending.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical opening, manifestation, and the parallel divine-address grammar; I infer that the mission operationalizes that opening. A live alternative is that 48:1 names an outcome while 48:8 independently lists offices.

changed_reading.before: The triad reports what the messenger says after an opening has occurred.
changed_reading.after: The triad is itself part of how closure is opened: evidence, first signs, and foresight make the opening cognitively and practically enterable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The before/after axis, protective covering, completion, and guidance recast the three roles as a corridor through time. Witnessing keeps the past from being erased, glad tidings announces incomplete good moving toward fullness, and warning steers the still-open future without denying protective repair.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-bearing declaration keeps the preceding record available rather than forgotten.
First signs mark a benefit that has begun but is not yet complete.
Awakened caution keeps the later horizon alterable through present response.
Covering fault while protecting its bearer supplies repair without simple erasure of the record.
Precedence and forward position give the witnessed record its backward temporal pole.
Deferral to a later time supplies the open future addressed by tidings and warning.
Arrival at completion gives glad tidings a trajectory rather than a static prize.
Gentle direction supplies the practical path through the temporal corridor.

structural_cues: 48:2 moves in sequence from what preceded, to what comes later, to completion, and then to a directed path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the temporal poles and repair-completion-guidance sequence; I assign the three focal roles different work along that sequence. A live alternative is that these are benefits to the messenger rather than mechanics of his commission.

changed_reading.before: Witness, good news, and warning are simultaneous speech acts.
changed_reading.after: They jointly carry a person through remembered fault, protected repair, emerging completion, and a future still responsive to guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated descents of tranquility into hearts, later opposed to heated pride and agitated ignorance, make the focal triad an affective regulator. Counterintuitively, warning need not add heat: a bounded danger can stop undirected agitation, while witnessed reality and glad countenance let the heart settle, grow, and adopt protective restraint.

activation_trace.role: Present seeing gives agitation a stable object instead of leaving it to imagination.
An open, well-formed countenance supplies the outward affective pole opposed to heated pride.
Warning converts diffuse fear into a specific object of caution and therefore can stabilize action.
Descending and settling supplies the vertical movement by which regulation reaches the heart.
Cessation of motion supplies the target state of affective regulation.
The heart supplies the interior site where the message's competing affects are integrated.
Growth shows that stillness is productive stabilization rather than inertness.
Heated pride and anger supply the dysregulated state that tranquility counters.
Lightness of restraint and disturbed temperament identify the heat as behavioral instability.
Protective deflection supplies the regulated action produced after the heart settles.

structural_cues: 48:4 and 48:26 repeat the descent of tranquility, while 48:26 explicitly places heated pride in hearts before that descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, stilling, heart, growth, heat, disturbed temperament, and protection; I infer that the focal communication participates in the transition. A live alternative is that tranquility acts directly and the three roles merely announce its consequences.

changed_reading.before: Glad tidings comforts, whereas warning necessarily agitates.
changed_reading.after: Witness, glad countenance, and bounded warning can operate together as a regulator that cools reactive pride into settled, protective agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored favorable and adverse destination clauses make the triad a bifurcating adjudicative interface. Witnessing supplies the evidentiary hinge; glad tidings opens entry toward protected flourishing; warning marks the turning circuit whose adverse consequence returns upon its holders.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based testimony supplies the evidentiary hinge between divergent outcomes.
Joy-opening news supplies the attractive force toward the favorable branch.
Danger notice exposes the adverse branch early enough for caution.
Entry into an interior gives the favorable outcome a directed threshold.
A garden enclosed by growth supplies the protected destination of glad tidings.
Attaining good and escaping harm condenses the favorable branch into successful passage.
A disastrous turn or defeat supplies the adverse branch's returning circuit.
Becoming an eventual outcome gives warning a terminal horizon rather than a passing alarm.

structural_cues: 48:5 and 48:6 are adjacent mirrored purpose clauses for believing men and women versus hypocritical and associating men and women.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired social groups and opposed destinations; I infer that witnessing mediates their disclosure while tidings and warning voice the two paths. A live alternative is that the outcomes surround but do not functionally depend on the witness role.

changed_reading.before: The three roles offer generic encouragement and deterrence.
changed_reading.after: They expose a consequential fork: testimony makes the fork answerable, tidings draws toward protected entry, and warning reveals a returning adverse circuit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate purpose clause and hand-to-hand pledge convert reception into a response cycle. The messenger's testimony is not neutral observation: it elicits supporting honor, gains covenantal embodiment in a pledge, and differentiates rupture from fulfillment, with tidings and warning naming the returns built into that bond.

activation_trace.role: Testimony that can support judgment makes the response covenant answerable.
Good news supplies the promised positive return of fulfilled allegiance.
Warning supplies advance notice of the self-directed consequence of rupture.
The messenger as carrier is repeated at the point where reception becomes belief and response.
Support joined to magnification turns hearing into active backing.
Weighty composure supplies the gravity with which the message is received.
The obedience pledge gives bodily and social form to the response.
Unraveling a bound covenant defines the warned failure mode.
Completion without deficiency defines the favorable response trajectory.
A preserved compact secures the relation across time.
Return for action gives the tidings side of the covenant a concrete consequence.

structural_cues: 48:9 begins with the purpose marker لِـ after the three roles, and 48:10 immediately stages repeated pledging, rupture, and fulfillment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit purpose clause followed by covenant mechanics; I infer that the focal triad initiates that response cycle. A live alternative is that witnessing remains observational while only later commands create the bond.

changed_reading.before: The audience receives information from an observing messenger.
changed_reading.after: Reception becomes a weighty covenantal act: testimony authenticates it, tidings names fulfillment's return, and warning names the cost of unraveling it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit mismatch between repeated sayings on tongues and what is absent from hearts activates a forensic reading. The witness tests whether visible expression manifests its owner; the bearer of tidings tests whether surface and interior form a whole; warning exposes speech whose attractive surface conceals an ungrounded inner forecast.

activation_trace.role: A tongue that manifests its owner supplies the criterion against which deceptive speech is tested.
Wholeness joining outer and inner supplies the integrity that surface-only speech lacks.
Warning makes the danger of a cosmetically convincing but inwardly empty forecast explicit.
Repeated utterance supplies the observable speech sample under examination.
The bodily organ of speech localizes the outward claim at the surface.
The heart supplies the concealed interior explicitly contrasted with the tongue.
Applied beautification explains how an unsupported forecast can acquire a persuasive surface.
Uncertain imagining supplies the ungrounded interior content hidden by that surface.

structural_cues: 48:11 states the tongue-heart mismatch directly, and 48:12 follows with beautified expectation and repeated supposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward speech, inward absence, beautification, and supposition; I infer that the focal witness role diagnoses their congruence. A live alternative is that the witness testifies to deeds generally rather than performing this specific inner-outer test.

changed_reading.before: A witness reports externally observable conduct.
changed_reading.after: The witness becomes a forensic interface that tests whether speech truly manifests the speaker, while tidings and warning distinguish grounded horizon from decorated projection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The attempted replacement of divine speech amid competing claims to follow activates a chain-of-custody reading. Sending carries a determinate saying, correspondence preserves it across parties, and witnessing authenticates continuity against substitution; tidings and warning then attach to the preserved message rather than opportunistic rewrites.

activation_trace.role: A carried saying and its bearer supply the content whose continuity must be preserved.
Correspondence across parties supplies a transmission chain vulnerable to or protected from substitution.
Decisive declaration from knowledge functions as authentication of the carried content.
Tracing an effect step by step makes following a test of continuity, not merely proximity.
Putting one thing in another's place supplies the exact threat to message continuity.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the transmitted object that substitution would alter.

structural_cues: 48:15 repeats claims of following on both sides of the stated desire to replace divine speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, substitution, and connecting speech; I infer a message-authentication function for the witness. A live alternative is that the witness concerns conduct while preservation of wording is secured independently.

changed_reading.before: The witness observes whether people accept the message.
changed_reading.after: The witness also functions as a checksum on the message itself, preserving a carried saying through contested claims of continuity and replacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The summons, conditional response, and triple exemption prevent warning from flattening unequal bodies into one demand. Warning awakens caution where action is possible; witnessing discerns actual capacity; glad tidings remains attached to willing obedience rather than physical performance beyond ability.

activation_trace.role: Present observation supplies attention to embodied capacity rather than an abstract audience.
Warning supplies actionable caution but is bounded by what can actually be done.
Capacity to perform supplies the threshold at which summons becomes accountable action.
Loss of sight supplies one concrete embodied limit explicitly exempted.
Removal of constriction prevents the warning from becoming an impossible burden.
Lameness supplies a second distinct limit on physical response.
Weakening and curtailed movement supply a third capacity constraint.

structural_cues: 48:17 repeats لَيْسَ ... حَرَجٌ three times before returning to the obedience-versus-turning outcome structure of 48:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit capacity limits inside a warning-and-reward frame; I infer that witnessing calibrates accountability to those limits. A live alternative is that the exemptions are a local legal qualification rather than a property of the focal commission.

changed_reading.before: Warning addresses every hearer with the same pressure to act.
changed_reading.after: Warning is capacity-sensitive: witness attends to embodied possibility, removes impossible constriction, and preserves accountability for willing response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated withholding of hands sets a striking counter-image to sending. One agency is released while another is restrained: the envoy's witnessing, tidings, and warning become a calibrated alternative to uncontrolled hand-action, producing a sign that can guide rather than merely overpower.

activation_trace.role: Release opposite holding supplies the dispatched agency contrasted with restrained hands.
Deliberate gentleness prevents the released agency from reproducing the violence being restrained.
An indicating sign makes restrained action readable as meaningful rather than as mere incapacity.
Active prevention supplies the withheld mode of agency paired with the sent messenger.
The bodily hand localizes the coercive action that is being stopped.
A visible sign converts restraint into evidence available for guidance.
Gentle direction names the non-coercive movement enabled by the sign.
The repeated prevention confirms that restraint is an active operation, not a single accidental pause.
Mutually checked force shows both sides' hand-power being bounded.

structural_cues: 48:20 and 48:24 repeat the same hand-restraint construction, with the first explicitly calling the result a sign and a cause of guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release within أَرْسَلْنَاكَ and repeated active restraint of hands; I infer a designed substitution of communicative agency for coercive agency. A live alternative is that the hand restraint is tactical and does not characterize the messenger's mode generally.

changed_reading.before: Being sent is unrestricted forward projection of authority.
changed_reading.after: The messenger is the deliberately released agency within a field of restrained hands, making testimony, hope, and caution instruments of guided non-coercive movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The concealed believers who could be trampled unknowingly make warning a protective epistemology rather than a threat alone. Witnessing must search for hidden persons before action; warning applies an epistemic brake where ignorance could turn success into harm; glad tidings keeps mercy and inclusion open until persons can be distinguished.

activation_trace.role: Presence with observation supplies the attention needed to detect lives hidden within a mixed field.
Knowledge-bearing evidence supplies the basis for stopping action under uncertainty.
Good news preserves a favorable horizon for persons whom a crude sorting would erase.
Danger notice becomes an early brake against unintended injury.
Disclosure to the knower marks the exact epistemic deficit around the concealed people.
Crushing pressure supplies the unintended physical harm that ignorance could cause.
An action striking its target shows how apparently directed force can hit the wrong persons.
A stain of harm supplies the social and moral residue of unknowing injury.
Merciful tenderness supplies the protected horizon kept open by restraint.
Separation and discrimination supply the missing operation required before force could be safely directed.

structural_cues: 48:25 embeds the explicit counterfactual that unknown believing men and women could be trampled, then makes separation the condition for a different outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden persons, ignorance, crushing contact, accidental impact, harm, mercy, and conditional separation; I infer that the focal witness-warning pair functions prospectively as an epistemic brake. A live alternative is that only divine knowledge, not the messenger's witness role, performs the protection.

changed_reading.before: Witnessing records harm and warning threatens those who cause it.
changed_reading.after: Witnessing and warning operate before harm: they slow action under mixed visibility so concealed lives can be distinguished and mercy preserved.

context_deltas.mechanism: The true dream, delayed safe entry, asymmetry of knowledge, and near opening turn the triad into a converter from vision to public event. Glad tidings names the first trace before realization, warning governs fear and timing during the gap, and witness arrives when the projected scene becomes embodied and inspectable.

activation_trace.role: Presence with seeing supplies the eventual public verification of the prior vision.
An indicating sign allows partial realization to testify before the full event.
A forerunner supplies the early visible stage of a promised but delayed outcome.
Caution governs conduct during the interval when the vision is true but not yet safely realizable.
The dream supplies the initially private image awaiting public embodiment.
Security and settled trust define the manner in which realization must occur.
Expected danger supplies the affect that warning regulates rather than simply amplifies.
Unequal disclosure explains why truthful vision and immediate human timing can diverge.
An opening that begins what follows supplies an intermediate realization rather than a failed promise.
Temporal nearness gives the forerunner a horizon without collapsing delay into immediacy.

structural_cues: 48:27 orders dream, promised entry, safety, absence of fear, unequal knowledge, and a nearer opening as distinct stages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the private vision and staged public fulfillment; I distribute the transition across tidings, warning, and witnessing. A live alternative is that the three focal roles announce the vision's truth without mediating its staged realization.

changed_reading.before: Glad tidings predicts a future that witness later confirms, while warning is separate.
changed_reading.after: The three roles jointly bridge vision and event: first trace, guarded interval, and safe public verification are successive modes of one commission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later reprise nests the one sent as witness inside the Sender's sufficient witness. The envoy carries guidance and stable truth into public manifestation, but does not become an autonomous guarantor; his embodied testimony is a delegated layer within a larger witness architecture.

activation_trace.role: The bearer and carried saying define the delegated human layer.
Evidence-bearing declaration defines the focal witness office that will be recursively framed.
The repeated sender-messenger relation reasserts that testimony remains carried and commissioned.
Gentle direction names what the delegated bearer carries into the world.
Obedient alignment supplies the field in which guidance is to become publicly effective.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the content guaranteed through both witness layers.
Emergence into visibility supplies the public effect of the messenger's embodied testimony.
The sufficient divine witness encloses and guarantees the commissioned human declaration.

structural_cues: 48:28 repeats both sending and witnessing from 48:8, but places the messenger between divine sending and the sufficiency of God's witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical reprise and the changed grammatical agents; I infer nested witness layers rather than competition between two witnesses. A live alternative is that the final witness simply confirms success and does not redefine the earlier office.

changed_reading.before: The messenger independently occupies the role of witness.
changed_reading.after: His witness is delegated and recursive: he manifests carried truth publicly while the Sender's sufficient witness guarantees the whole transmission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final visible marks and staged crop growth make the three offices generative rather than merely individual. Dispatch proceeds into successive embodiment; witness becomes a readable communal trace; glad tidings appears as the first shoot and strengthening growth; warning remains present as the same visible formation produces a sharply opposed affect in resistant observers.

activation_trace.role: Successive groups extend dispatch from one envoy into a propagated collective pattern.
A sign indicating condition allows the community's visible form to become testimony.
First shoots and early signs supply the beginning of a favorable development.
The same public formation warns by awakening an adverse, resistant reaction.
A visible mark from which condition is inferred makes communal embodiment evidentiary.
The face supplies the public human surface on which the trace is read.
A remaining sign that points back to prior action supplies durable witness.
Cultivated emergence and growth supply the generative process initiated by the mission.
A shoot emerging beside its root supplies the first propagated body beyond the origin.
Plants strengthening one another make growth reciprocal rather than centrally transmitted only.
Thickening after thinness supplies maturation from fragile sign to durable form.
Standing settled upon support supplies the mature stability of the collective trace.
The stalk as carrier supplies the support on which propagated growth can stand.
Chest-held anger supplies the resistant affect through which the same visible sign also warns.

structural_cues: 48:29 moves from a mark on faces through a tightly sequenced chain of emergence, mutual strengthening, thickening, standing, admiration, and anger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible traces and a staged growth mechanism; I infer that the messenger's three functions reproduce as a communal phenotype. A live alternative is that the crop image characterizes the companions independently rather than tracing propagation of the focal offices.

changed_reading.before: Witness, bearer of tidings, and warner remain three offices located in one envoy.
changed_reading.after: The commission propagates: a community becomes visible testimony, its first shoots embody glad development, and its mature visibility also warns by exposing resistance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because أَرْسَلْنَاكَ normally foregrounds outbound dispatch, while 48:12 joins a feared failure to return with the same root that names hearts. It remains anchored through the focus root's release and correspondence branches and the later messenger occurrence. Render it as a possible feedback topology, not as a claim that sending lexically means returning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَرْسَلْنَاكَ as release and correspondence, activated by the imagined non-return of the messenger in 48:12.

activation_trace.role: Outbound release supplies the half-circuit that the context falsely imagines as terminal.
Correspondence and accompaniment keep open a relational circuit beyond one-way departure.
The repeated messenger occurrence locates the imagined broken return inside the same carried relation.
Turning back and arriving at a destination supply the missing return vector, while the shared root occurrence also touches the inner site of the false model.
Permanent non-departure from a state hardens the mistaken one-way forecast into imagined finality.

changed_reading.before: Sending is a one-way departure whose success is delivery at the far end.
changed_reading.after: The commission may be carried as a circuit of departure, correspondence, witnessed response, and return; despair falsely cuts that circuit after its first vector.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the wound-compensation branch of ن ذ ر and the splinting branch of ء ج ر rather than their usual focal senses. It remains anchored in نَذِيرًا, the witness's evidentiary branch, and the nearby promised أَجْرًا. Render it as a legal-material analogy in which warning notices liability and promised return repairs a break, not as a lexical replacement for warning or reward.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَذِيرًا beside شَاهِدًا and مُبَشِّرًا, with the later covenant's promised أَجْرًا.

activation_trace.role: A wound carrying an owed compensation turns warning into notice that injury creates an accountable claim.
Knowledge-based testimony supplies the evidence by which the injury and its claim become decidable.
Joy-opening news supplies the positive prospect that accountability can lead to repair.
Splinting a break on its crookedness supplies the material image of promised return as repair.
Full completion without deficiency supplies the criterion for adequate repair.

changed_reading.before: Warning threatens injury, while glad tidings promises an unrelated reward.
changed_reading.after: Warning can also announce that injury generates liability; witness establishes the claim, and glad return images a repair made whole.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material reading is surprising because it crosses milk-flow, honey-in-comb, and surface-removal branches that are remote from the ordinary offices. It remains focus-anchored in all three role roots and gains a context echo from emergence out of concealment. Render it only as an analogy for controlled disclosure: nourishing content is released from a containing matrix without claiming these branch images are the verse's direct denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا, read through flow, contained sweetness, and removal of a surface.

activation_trace.role: Continuous nutritive flow supplies a material image for sustained release rather than a single utterance.
Honey still held in its comb supplies content that is present and real before extraction.
Removing an outer layer supplies the disclosure operation that exposes contained content.
Awakened caution constrains extraction so disclosure does not become destructive stripping.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the context echo for disclosure from a containing matrix.

changed_reading.before: The commission transfers already explicit propositions from sender to audience.
changed_reading.after: It can be imagined as controlled extraction: real but contained nourishment is brought through a surface into sustained circulation, with warning governing the force of exposure.

strongest_changes: Dispatch became calibrated release: the messenger is sent while hands are actively withheld.
Witnessing became prospective and protective: hidden lives must be discerned before action, not merely recorded after harm.
Glad tidings and warning became paired affective regulators that can cool heated pride into settled, guarded agency.
The tongue-heart contrast made witness a test of inner-outer integrity and message continuity.
The closing reprise nested the envoy's witness inside divine witness, then propagated the three functions into a visible growing community.
summary.what_was_special: The focus-only title sequence repeatedly changed into mechanisms: a temporal relay, embodied surface, calibrated release, covenant authentication, epistemic brake, affective cooling, staged realization, recursive witness, and collective growth. Branch-distant legal and material activations remained live with explicit containment instead of being discarded.
remaining_uncertainties: The direction from contextual outcomes back into the mechanics of the three focal roles is abductive rather than grammatically explicit.
The order witness-tidings-warning may encode a temporal relay, a rhetorical balance, or both.
48:28 may genuinely redistribute witness across divine and human layers, or may simply reconfirm the earlier commission.
The return-circuit, reparative-liability, and contained-extraction readings are analogical branch activations and should not be presented as lexical substitutions.
